==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Has been a fan of Turkish football club [[wikipedia:en:Galatasaray_S.K._(football)|Galatasaray]] since his childhood.
* Was banned in [[TCL 2017 Winter]] for 2 games after he played music that insulted his opponents from [[Fenerbahçe Esports]]. <ref>[https://www.instagram.com/reel/DA5-0InIpfK/ Offline Tonight] 'youtube.com'</ref>
* Is a dual citizen of Germany and Turkey.
* First Turkish resident to play in the LCS. 
* Was the subject of good-natured memes by his teammates after joining [[TSM]] regarding his short stature. 
* His ID is a reference to the weapon of the champion {{ci|Riven}}.
* Is the 3rd player to win a title in both [[LEC]] and [[LCS]] after [[Zven]] and [[Perkz]].
* Nicknamed "The Topfather" by fans. He plays into this nickname by imitating Vito Corleone in [[G2]] content. <ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v5a9yjQ1acs The Topfather] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on May 24, 2025.
** The 16th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC.

 
=== Individual Awards ===
* x1 LEC Finals MVP (Winter 2024)
* x4 LEC 1st All-Pro Team (Summer 2022, Summer 2023, Winter 2024, Spring 2024)
* x2 LEC 2nd All-Pro Team (Spring 2022, Winter 2023)
* x2 LCS 3rd All-Pro Team (Spring 2019, Spring 2020)
